## Publication Information

**Date:** 1883

**Genre:** Fiction

**Publisher:** Macmillan and Co., London.

**Notes:** The signatures of the nine authors appear on the reverse of the title page. They are: Frances Awdry, Mary Bramston, Christabel Rose Coleridge, A.E. Mary Anderson Morshead, Charlotte Mary Yonge, Frances Mary Peard, Mary Susanna Lee, Eleanor C. Price, Florence Wilford.
